info.title: OMS Connection List Service
info.description: Use this API to manage a TD/OMS connection list. A connection list is the set of objects selected to be connected to a task. It acts as the staging area or shopping cart before actually connecting the object to the task. The service supports IBM i objects and IFS stream files. Use /add to add an object or IFS object to the connection list, /process to process the selected connection list by connecting the objects to the tasl, /delete to remove entries from the connection list, and /change to change the solution type for an entry. All operations require a bearer JWT token.

servers.description: TD/OMS connection list service endpoint. Replace variables with the target IBM i host, TD/OMS library, protocol, and port.

port.description: The port to which the server is listening

tags.name: Connection List
tags.description: Operations for adding, processing, deleting, and changing objects in a TD/OMS connection list.

/add.summary: Add an object to the connection list
/add.description: Adds an IBM i object or IFS stream file to the current user's TD/OMS connection list. Use this operation when the user wants to stage or select an object for later TD/OMS processing. For IBM i objects, set ifsObject to *OBJC. For IFS stream files, set objectType to *STMF and provide the full ifsObject path.

post.summary: Add an object to the connection list
post.description: Adds an IBM i object or IFS stream file to the current user's TD/OMS connection list. Use this operation when the user wants to stage or select an object for later TD/OMS processing. For IBM i objects, set ifsObject to *OBJC. For IFS stream files, set objectType to *STMF and provide the full ifsObject path.

requestBody.description: Object, task, and processing options for adding an entry to the connection list.

200.description: The TD/OMS action completed normally or returned a terminal TD/OMS status in the response body.

post.x-ai-usage-note: Before calling this operation, collect the TD/OMS application code, task number, object identity, object type, and whether the target is an IBM i object or an IFS stream file. Use defaults only when the user did not provide a value and the default is explicitly defined in the schema.

/process.description: Processes the selected object, IFS stream file, or wildcard selection from a TD/OMS connection list. Use this operation after entries have been added and the user asks to process or execute the connection list action. Set forced to 1 only when the user explicitly asks to force processing.

post.description: Processes the selected object, IFS stream file, or wildcard selection from a TD/OMS connection list. Use this operation after entries have been added and the user asks to process or execute the connection list action. Set forced to 1 only when the user explicitly asks to force processing.

/delete.summary: Delete entries from the connection list
/delete.description: Deletes selected entries from a TD/OMS connection list. Use this operation when the user wants to remove an object from the list, not when the user wants to delete the object from IBM i or from IFS storage.

/change.description: Changes a selected connection list entry, including its solution type. Use this operation when the user wants to alter how an existing entry will be handled, for example changing the solution type to *COMPILE.

applicationCode.description: TD/OMS application code. This identifies the application that owns the task and object selection. Example: XMP.

connectionListCode.description: Connection list to use. Use *USER for the current authenticated user's connection list.

taskNumber.description: TD/OMS task number that contains or receives the selected object. Example: T0497.

objectCode.description: IBM i object name, IFS object selector, or wildcard depending on the operation. For /add, pass the object name such as PFCONV or an IFS stream file name such as dashboard.js. For /process, /delete, and /change, use *ALL to select all eligible entries or *IFSOBJ when selecting an IFS object.

objectLibrary.description: IBM i object library that contains the object. For IFS stream files, pass the value expected by TD/OMS for the IFS object library field. The mapping of the library field is stored in table OMIOP.

objectType.description: IBM i object type, for example *FILE, *PGM, *SRVPGM, or *STMF for an IFS stream file.

memberCode.description: IBM i source or database file member. Use *NONE when no member applies.

ifsObject.description: IFS object path. Use *OBJC when the selected object is a normal IBM i object. For IFS stream files, pass the full path, for example /QOpenSys/OMSIFS/XMP/PRD/PHP/htdocs/public/js/dashboard.js.

solutionType.description: TD/OMS solution type to assign to the connection list entry. Use *CHANGE for a normal change, *COMPILE for compile-related work, or *TERMINATE to terminate processing.

addData.description: Object or IFS stream file data to add to the TD/OMS connection list.

status.description: The return status which can be *NORM or *TERM. In case of *TERM look at the messages for more information.

messageType.description: IBM i message severity/type. Empty string can be returned for informational messages; E indicates an error.

messageText.example: Action *ADD for connection list ALICE in application XMP completed normally.

applicationRelation.description: Whether TD/OMS should include application relations while adding the object. Use 0 for no, 1 for yes.
